title: Fall Sesshin
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The teacher invites the audience to practice a way of being that allows them to let go of control and ego, embracing instead a sense of "not controlling anything." This means releasing attachment to specific outcomes or opinions, and instead allowing things to unfold naturally. By doing so, we can create space for others to be their true selves, and support each other in living authentic lives.
